Asha (CS): Quick week0 smoke for NovaGrid private deploy. TL;DR: network & IAM ok; two blockers: audit logs missing sessionContext and KMS rotation failed due to alias mismatch. Tagging @Kai @Liam.

Kai (Platform): Paste the log sample + exact KMS error so I can reproduce.

Asha (CS): Log snip: eventTime=2026-03-02T14:22:01Z, eventName=StartInstances, userIdentity type=AssumedRole arn=arn:aws:sts::999999999999:assumed-role/NovaCrossAcct/DeployRole — sessionContext not present. Rotation error: "Error: KMS alias \"alias/novagrid-prod-enc\" not found" but actual alias is alias/novagrid-prod-enc-2026.

Liam (Security): Missing sessionContext usually means CloudTrail or the delivery pipeline is omitting it. Check CloudTrail includeManagementEvents and whether a forwarder strips fields. Also verify the log-delivery role permissions.

DeployBot: smoke-runner: 1786123456 | checks: network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail | artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/novagrid/week0/1786123456

Asha (CS): Plan: (1) Kai to add alias suffix fallback to rotation script and push patch by EOD; (2) Liam to validate CloudTrail + delivery pipeline and update runbook to require sessionContext passthrough if needed; (3) If unresolved by Fri 18:00 PT, mark medium renewal risk and schedule customer call.
